Спорт — это sport, а занятие спортом — to do sport или to go in for sport.
play football, do gymnastics, go swimming
I have a headache. / My back hurts.
My brother plays hockey in a team.
Today he has a cold, so he should stay at home and take some medicine.
С названиями игр используй play, с -ing — go, с гимнастикой и йогой — do.
